persona: Field business development executive with three years selling facility services to SMEs
resumeText:
Rohan Deshmukh | Pune | rohan.deshmukh@example.com

- Update every lead, visit and deal stage in Zoho CRM and share a daily visit report.

Sales Trainee, Kesari Office Supplies, Pune (2022 - 2023)
- Visited shops and offices in Kothrud to take orders for stationery and printer supplies.

Contract negotiation, MS Excel, Marathi, Hindi, English
